autonomous_brain_reasoning: Evaluated sensor alert; ventilation flow drop detected simultaneously with volatile organic gas sensor trip. Recommended evacuation of Block B 2nd floor, emergency ventilation shut-off, and hazmat protocol activation.
executed_solution: Lab locked, exhaust fan bypassed to industrial scrubber, neutralizer sodium bicarbonate powder applied by trained safety officer.
outcome_result: Zero injuries; air quality returned to normal PPM levels within 40 minutes.
preventative_measure: Instituted bi-weekly gasket integrity audit and dual-redundancy backup exhaust fans.

incident_title: Main DG Genset Trip during Board Mock Examinations
root_cause_analysis: Phase unbalance caused by simultaneous high-draw startup of 14 classroom HVAC compressor units.
autonomous_brain_reasoning: Autonomous Brain detected 415V three-phase imbalance exceeding 18% threshold; isolated HVAC feeder circuits to protect central UPS power supplying server rooms and examination hall lighting.
executed_solution: Genset restarted under load-shedded state within 90 seconds. Staggered compressor restarts introduced at 30-second delays.
outcome_result: Mock exams proceeded uninterrupted; no data loss on student online assessment servers.
preventative_measure: Implemented automated microcontroller-based staggered startup logic for all central air handlers.
